research_question: Do the parameter-efficiency advantages of the fixed bottleneck-plus-expansion architectures discovered on MNIST generalize to Fashion-MNIST without architecture search on the new dataset?
observations: Exp008 retained h64_512 and h128_512 as parameter-efficient alternatives to wider single-layer controls on full MNIST.
Continuing to tune on MNIST would provide weaker evidence than testing the fixed architectures on a distinct dataset.
hypothesis: Without changing the architectures, h64_512 and/or h128_512 remain Pareto-efficient relative to h128, h256, and h512 on Fashion-MNIST.
falsification_criterion: The generalization hypothesis is weakened if the expansion architectures lose their accuracy-versus-parameter advantage and the matched single-layer controls dominate or replace them on the Pareto front.
limitations: Fashion-MNIST is still a small grayscale image benchmark.
CPU backend results cannot be interpreted as photonic hardware performance.
